name: @nkdb/proto
description: Shared Protocol Buffers Schemas & Generated Types for SmartBoat 4.0

scripts.build:proto: mkdir -p src/generated && pbjs -t static-module -w commonjs -o src/generated/proto.js proto/*.proto && pbts -o src/generated/proto.d.ts src/generated/proto.js
scripts.build:ts: tsc && mkdir -p dist/generated && cp -r src/generated/* dist/generated/
scripts.build: pnpm run build:proto && pnpm run build:ts
